description: Implementation of the PricingService interface, providing methods to calculate product prices, format amounts, and handle currency display within a shopping cart or catalog context.

classes.name: PricingServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing product pricing logic, including calculation and display methods for product prices and amounts.

methods.name: calculateProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final price for a product, optionally considering customer and product attributes.

methods.name: getDisplayAmount
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the amount with currency for display purposes, formatted for store currency.

methods.name: getDisplayAmount
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the amount with currency considering locale and currency, for display purposes.

methods.name: getStringAmount
methods.description: Returns a formatted admin string of the amount for store management or backend display.
